[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Diagonal traverse** [LC 498 · Diagonal Traverse](https://leetcode.com/problems/diagonal-traverse/){difficulty="Medium"}

Every anti-diagonal is pinned by one number, $s = i + j$ (@sec-mat-a2), so the matrix is a stack of $m + n - 1$ bands $s = 0, 1, \dots, m+n-2$. The zig-zag is a property of the band, not of any cell: read band $s$ upward (bottom-left to top-right) when $s$ is even and downward when $s$ is odd.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p1-diag.]{.card-link}

:::
